comment: S512+PPXL's tensors as Fork's training program saves them (tools/train --arch s512ppxl; bake-off round 3's x_lower arm, owner 2026-11-14, architecture 10), in save order: the 768 piece rows, then the 640 exposure rows (XGR's exposure plane, its 10-input factoriser merged in when saved, with the rule's lower-class half only: a non-king piece attacked by an enemy piece of a lower class), then the 608 pawn-link rows of rank limit 1 (S512+PP's), the output layer transposed to one bucket's weights per row; read by convert.py and reference.py. The phase table is S512+PP's (s512pp.json), so a warm start from an S512+PP net keeps its output buckets.
name: s512ppxl
